preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 34 narrates the death and burial of Moses on Mount Nebo. The chapter is canonically remarkable for being narrated as if Moses witnessed his own death; rabbinic tradition discusses the question (b. Bava Batra 14b–15a). No substantial 4QDeut manuscript preserves this final chapter.
preamble.notable_variants: No DSS variants documented; coverage is essentially absent.
preamble.scroll_condition: No substantial Qumran attestation. The reconstructed text is therefore the MT.
